name: Ukishi Misora
source:
Element: Lithium
Rank: 純弐位
Hobby/Skill: Piano

The fashionable leader of the Defense Headquarters. Looks and talks like a flirt, but is well versed in science and technology, as well as possessing a deep knowledge of culture and art. 
He hates conservative and egocentric thinking, and his motto is to live life in his own way.
